purpose: Remove the normalized fixed-window four-partition artifact without changing GraSU or ReGraph compute resources.

observed_native_behavior.hbm_assignment: subpartitions assigned to fixed CU-connected HBM banks
observed_native_behavior.execution: partitions sharing one CU queue execute in queue order; distinct CUs may overlap
observed_native_behavior.capacity: sum of buffers assigned to a pseudo-channel must remain below physical bank capacity

footprints.pma_segments: 64 * ceil(reserved_segments / 2) bytes per pseudo-channel per partition
footprints.source_state: two 4KiB-aligned buffers over padded destination-partition capacity

unchanged_architecture: GraSU search, dispatch, cache, and DDR CU counts
ReGraph compute-pipeline count and shared-downstream policy
AXI widths, outstanding limits, and arbitration
HBM pseudo-channel count, capacity, timing, and bandwidth

claim_boundary.matching_routed_worker: K1 compute kernels retain routed evidence; runtime multi-partition allocation is simulator structural evidence
